name: Kyushu Leasing Service Co., Ltd.
summary: Kyushu Leasing Service Co., Ltd. operates as a financial services company in Japan. The company operates through Leasing/Installment, Finance, Real Estate, Fee Business, and Environmental Solutions segments. It is also involved in the leasing and installment sales of machinery and equipment, including car and building leasing, energy services, and subsidies and taxation system leasing; provision of project finance; rental of real estate properties; and other real estate business. In addition, the company provides life and non-life insurance products and services.
